## Biography

I am a **Postdoctoral Researcher at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU)**, working with Kim Branner on structural health monitoring, digital twins, computer vision, and predictive maintenance for wind turbines.

I received my D.Sc. (Tech.) in Civil Engineering from Aalto University in 2023, supervised by Weiwei Lin. My doctoral thesis, [*Bridge health condition assessment using instrumented moving vehicles*](https://aaltodoc.aalto.fi/handle/123456789/123671), received a Dean's Doctoral Dissertation Award. Before joining DTU, I held research positions at Aalto University and Politecnico di Milano.

My research spans structural dynamics, drive-by inspection, damage identification, Bayesian inference, and learning-based monitoring. I combine signal processing and numerical models with laboratory and field measurements.
